summary: Revise at 6.6 (round 1: 6.2; Caiman: 7; ship bar: 7.5; Corvus was cut at 6.6 and Kraken at 7.0). Every recorded gate is green and matches report.json. The template gate is still not recorded, and it must be before a ship. The move to factory 017 Tonneau fixed round 1's worst defect: the head-to-bore junction is now one clean curve on both the bare and the finished ring (bare-vs-finished, palm). Bark now covers the head walls. The face leaves are wider obovate teardrops instead of paddles. Collet spacing is up to 0.34 mm, and the face triplets now read as three separate seats. At 300 px it still reads as mistletoe, from the Y forks and the white berry triplets. Four punch items were not done or not done well enough. (1) Every stem joint is still a pinched knot. Each node shows torn, diamond-shaped slits and crease holes (stones.png, face.png, shoulder-close.png); this was round 1's punch item 1. (2) The crossed four-leaf node at the left end of the face stalk is unchanged. It is the strongest shape in hero-300 and reads as a dragonfly; it was punch items 4 and 6 and read test 4's change 2. (3) The berries are still flat, opaque grey with visible facets. stones.json still has transmission 0.35, against the 0.6 asked for. (4) The bark is wavy, layered streaks that smear and comb (side.png, shoulder.png, shoulder-close.png), not crisp oak furrows. It stops at the head walls, so the shank from the shoulder clusters to the palm is still mostly bare mirror gold. There is also a new defect. 'Face berry 5' (facing [0.47, 0.52, 0.71]) sits in a collet tipped about 45 degrees, hanging off the lower-right edge of the table on a spur (face.png, side.png top right, reverse.png left). The shoulder leaves are small crumpled lumps. Density is still well below Caiman's: one sprig on a large table, and four islands of berries. One round remains. It can reach 7.5 only if the joints, the cross node, the berry material, the stray collet and the bark are all fixed.
strengths: The change to 017 Tonneau removed the torn, stair-stepped head-to-bore junction. In bare-vs-finished.png and palm.png the underside is now one clean curve.
It still reads as mistletoe at 300 px from the dichotomous Y fork and the white berry triplets in the crotches. Nothing reads as a flower.
The face leaves are now obovate teardrops, widest toward the tip, with a pillowed crown. They are much closer to mistletoe than round 1's paddles.
The collets are separated: closest_stones is 0.34 mm, up from 0.14, and every face triplet shows three distinct seats.
The bough runs over the face rim and down both shoulders, so the face and shoulders read as one plant. The tonneau's barrel table and hard corner faces are kept (bare-vs-finished, shoulder.png).

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: The face and shoulders share the sprig, and bark now covers the head walls. The bark stops at the head, though, so the shank from the shoulder clusters to the palm is bare polished gold apart from a few faint grooves (palm.png, reverse.png right, shoulder.png left). The shoulder berry clusters sit as four separate islands.

checklist.item: Reads as its plant at 300 px without caption
checklist.reason: In face-300 the Y-forked stalk and the white triplets say mistletoe, and the wider leaves help. It is still a weak pass. In hero-300 the crossed four-leaf node at the left end is the strongest shape on the ring and reads as a dragonfly, and the grey berries read as pearls.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true outlines, crisp, no combing or smearing
checklist.reason: The leaf outlines are clean. But every stem node is still a pinched knot with diamond-shaped slits and torn creases (face.png at the four left nodes and both fork tips, stones.png, shoulder-close.png). The bark on the head walls renders as smeared, combed, wavy layers rather than crisp furrows (side.png, shoulder-close.png lower left). The shoulder leaves are crumpled lumps.

checklist.item: Stones in made settings, visible, coloured as fruit or buds
checklist.reason: The collets are made, visible and now separated (0.34 mm). The stones are still opaque flat grey with visible faceting (shoulder-close.png, stones.png), and stones.json has transmission 0.35. 'Face berry 5' is set tipped about 45 degrees, in a collet hanging off the table's lower-right edge on a spur. It is not a made setting that reads as intended (face.png, side.png).

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms sculpted
checklist.reason: The face leaves are now sculpted pillows, which is better. The stems are still uniform tubes broken by mechanical pinched nodes, and the collets are flat-walled machined cylinders. The left node is a rigid symmetric cross.

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: The 017 Tonneau table keeps its crisp rim and corner faces (bare-vs-finished.png, shoulder.png), and the junction underneath is now clean.

checklist.item: Silhouette distinct from other Vepres rings
checklist.reason: A barrel-table signet with a berried bough breaking over its ends is unlike Ilex's 006 box, Prunus's cushion with a sloe, and the vine rings.

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: Large form: the table. Medium: the sprig and the triplets. Small: only the smeared bark on the head walls. About 40% of the face table is bare (top-left and bottom-centre in face.png), and the lower shank is bare. This is well below Caiman's full coverage.

gates.verified: Draft, coarse and export are all watertight, with 0 degenerate faces, 0 boundary edges and 0 non-manifold edges.

gates.gate: 0 self-crossings on ring and every made part
gates.verified: self_crossings is 0 at every build. All 45 made_parts entries have 0 self-crossings, 0 open edges and 0 non-manifold edges.
solids_notes [] and parts_notes [] at draft, coarse and export.
bore_margin_mm is -4.7e-7, which is floating-point zero, so nothing intrudes.

gates.gate: Field verdict Castable (judged as lost wax)
gates.verified: field_verdict is 'Castable' at all three builds. The two-part undercut notes (the bark at 234-317 degrees, and the stored part meshes) are informational under wax.

gates.gate: Lost wax thinnest wall >= 0.8 mm (replaces sand pull, ray release and clamp)
Stone count equals preview; no metal in stones
gates.verified: stones_reported 21, stones_previewed 21, metal_inside_stones [], stone_warnings []. closest_stones is 0.34 mm (B2.1 to B2.2).
casting_pattern is watertight, with 0 degenerate faces and 0 self-crossings; pass is true.
Not yet run: report.json has no template block and there is no verification.json. It is not counted against this round, but it must be recorded green before any ship.

punch_list.zone: Every stem node: the 'Face stem 1-4' joins (the four nodes left of the main fork and both fork tips) and the 'Shoulder bough A1-B2' and 'Shoulder twig' joins
punch_list.change: Carried over from round 1, punch item 1, which was not done. Remove the pinched waists and the diamond-shaped slits and holes at every node. Model each node as one swollen ellipsoid, about 1.3x the stem diameter and 1.6x it long. Union it with both stems at blend_mm >= 0.3, or make each branch one continuous sweep through the node, with no end caps meeting inside it.
punch_list.acceptance: In face.png, stones.png and shoulder-close.png every node is a smooth bulge on a continuous stalk, with no slit, hole, pinch or torn crease.

punch_list.zone: Face sprig, the left end of the stalk (the crossed four-leaf node, face.png x about 300-650)
punch_list.change: Carried over from round 1, punch items 4 and 6, and read test 4's change 2. Replace the cross of four leaves at one node with two opposite pairs on successive forks: fork the stalk once more about 2 mm in from the left rim, and put one leaf pair on each tine, angled 30-45 degrees off the tine. Use that pair to fill the bare top-left and bottom-centre of the table, to within 1.5 mm of the rim.
punch_list.acceptance: In hero-300.png and face-300.png no group of leaves reads as a cross, an X, a propeller or a dragonfly. In face.png no quadrant of the table is more than about 25% bare gold.

punch_list.zone: 'Face berry 5' and its collet and mound (lower-right corner of the face, girdle [7.50, 14.31, 4.01])
punch_list.change: Re-seat it on the table, facing within 15 degrees of the face normal (about [0.04, 0.98, 0.18], like Face berry 4 and 6). Pull it at least 1 mm inside the table rim, and remove the spur under it.
punch_list.acceptance: In face.png, side.png and reverse.png all three berries of the lower-right triplet sit upright on the table, and no collet overhangs the rim or stands on a spur.

punch_list.zone: All 21 moonstones (stones.json 'Moonstone' material) and the stone mesh reference-moonstone.stl
punch_list.change: Carried over from round 1, punch item 7, and read test 4's change 3. Raise transmission from 0.35 to at least 0.6, warm the tint toward [0.98, 0.96, 0.90], and add a soft subsurface or inner glow. Smooth the cabochon so no facets show at shoulder-close scale: use more segments or smooth normals.
punch_list.acceptance: In hero-300.png the berries read as waxy, translucent white fruit, not grey pearls. In shoulder-close.png and stones.png no faceting is visible on any stone.

punch_list.zone: The 'Oak bark, walls' and 'Oak bark, cheeks' layers: head walls, plus shank theta about 40-150 on both sides down to the palm crest
punch_list.change: Re-author the bark so it renders crisp. Use discrete furrows running round the ring, 0.6-1.0 mm apart, 0.3-0.35 mm deep, with sharp ridges and plates broken every 2-4 mm, instead of the current smeared, wavy laminations. Use an atlas resolution or tiling that does not comb. Extend it from under the shoulder clusters down both shank walls to 1 mm short of the palm crest and the bore edge.
punch_list.acceptance: In side.png, shoulder.png and shoulder-close.png the bark reads as crisp, ridged oak bark with no combing, smearing or layered streaks. In palm.png and reverse.png no bare mirror wall is wider than about 3 mm outside the palm crest.

punch_list.change: Rebuild the shoulder leaves to match the face leaves: obovate pillow blades about 2.5 x 1.2 mm on a short petiole, smooth and not crumpled. Pair them at the twig nodes.
punch_list.acceptance: In shoulder-close.png and reverse.png each shoulder leaf reads as a small clean obovate leaf, with no crumpled or folded lumps.

punch_list.change: Carried over from round 1, punch item 8. Taper each stem about 30% from base to tip, and add a 3-5 degree kink at each fork.
punch_list.acceptance: In face.png and shoulder.png the stems visibly thin toward the berries, and no segment reads as a straight uniform tube.

punch_list.change: Run the template lift and record its block: a byte-identical cold evaluation, at most 4 design.set patches, size and open time.
punch_list.acceptance: report.json or verification.json records the template gate green, with at most 4 design.set patches within the class budget.
